name: Tectonic Leap
pages: Launch forward from the ground, or dive while airborne. Landing within five seconds releases a seven-block shockwave that damages, slows, and throws back up to ten visible enemies without breaking terrain. Fall damage is suppressed only during this landing window. Ten-second base cooldown. Survival of the Fittest increases the shockwave's damage and radius. Requires the complete matching Apocalypse suit.
